entry.title: Kiba Labs, LLC — Makers of KibaOS
entry.summary: Kiba Labs, LLC makes KibaOS: a calm, free, open-source desktop that never collects or sells your data. Our mission, how we work, and what we build.

entry.title: KibaOS — Fast. Simple. Limitless.
entry.summary: KibaOS is a free, user-friendly Linux desktop: the KibaDE environment, based on ChromiumOS Ash via the Lumen fork of Chromium, on an Arch Linux base. Free forever.

entry.title: Download KibaOS
entry.summary: Download KibaOS free from SourceForge. Try it from a live USB stick before installing — no commitment, no data collection.
